title: CDAE: Enhancing Perturbation Robustness in Pretrained Language Models with Contrastive Denoising
abstract: arXiv:2607.28236v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Pre-trained language models have significantly improved sentence representation learning, yet their embeddings remain sensitive to textual perturbations such as synonym substitution, masking, and word dropout. This work proposes a lightweight Contrastive Denoising Autoencoder (CDAE) that refines pre-trained BERT embeddings by jointly optimizing contrastive and reconstruction objectives to learn perturbation-invariant representations. We evaluate the proposed framework under multiple perturbation strategies and strengths, and compare it against the original BERT embeddings and SimCSE. Experimental results show that CDAE consistently preserves higher embedding similarity under perturbation, with the gap widening as the perturbation strength increases, highlighting perturbation-invariant learning as a promising direction for improving the stability of sentence embeddings. The source code is publicly available at: https://github.com/Comp

translated_title: CDAE：利用对比去噪增强预训练语言模型的扰动鲁棒性
translated_abstract: 预训练语言模型显著提升了句子表示学习的效果，但其嵌入表示仍然对同义词替换、掩码和词丢弃等文本扰动十分敏感。本工作提出了一种轻量级的对比去噪自编码器（CDAE），通过联合优化对比目标和重建目标来精炼预训练BERT的嵌入表示，从而学习到对扰动不变的表示。我们在多种扰动策略和强度下评估了所提出的框架，并将其与原始BERT嵌入和SimCSE进行了比较。实验结果表明，CDAE在扰动下始终保持着更高的嵌入相似度，且随着扰动强度的增加，这一差距进一步扩大，凸显了扰动不变学习是提升句子嵌入稳定性的一种有前景的方向。源代码已公开发布于：https://github.com/Comp
tldr: 提出一种轻量级对比去噪自编码器CDAE，通过联合优化对比与重建目标学习扰动不变的句子表示，显著增强了预训练语言模型嵌入对文本扰动的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: Proposes a lightweight Contrastive Denoising Autoencoder (CDAE) that jointly optimizes contrastive and reconstruction objectives to learn perturbation-invariant sentence representations, significantly enhancing the robustness of pretrained language model embeddings against textual perturbations.
